sloka: रुद्रकालाविव क्रुद्धौ तदा तौ राक्षसार्जुनौ ।परस्परं गदाभ्यां तौ ताडयामासतुर्भृशम् ।। ७.३२.५३ ॥
transliteration: rudrakālāviva kruddhau tadā tau rākṣasārjunau ।parasparaṁ gadābhyāṁ tau tāḍayāmāsaturbhṛśam ।। 7.32.53 ॥

translations.english: Then, those two, the demon Ravana and Arjuna, enraged like Rudra and Kala, fiercely struck each other with their maces.
